correctness.rationale: The prior independent proof check stands. Conditioning on an ordered set of j labels missed by all n images gives independent uniform images in its complement; no deleted vertex is cyclic. Summing the indicators proves the factorial transfer, and the binomial expansion gives the PGF. The case j=n has probability zero. Forest enumeration gives the mass k(n)_k/n^(k+1), including k=n, and its telescoping survival (n)_k/n^k is increasing with n and strictly so at k=2. The j=1 transfer therefore proves the strict covariance for increasing h. For the size difference of the cyclic mean the survival-product corrections are i/((n-1)(n-i)); for k/sqrt(n)→x their sum times n tends to x²/2 and the product error is quadratic in that sum. The bound C k²/n² times exp(-k(k-1)/(2n)) up to n/2 and the exponentially small far tail justify the half-Gaussian moment integral. This yields sqrt(n)(E K_n−E K_(n−1))→sqrt(pi/2)/2, giving the negative covariance limit. The Rayleigh and empty-box variance coefficients are 2−pi/2 and e^(−1)−2e^(−2); these give the claimed correlation limit.
residual_risks: The previous replay is finite, not a proof of the limits; its original script is not included in the supplied prior-work folder. The asymptotic proof is analytic.
The conclusion requires uniform self-maps; h in the strictly increasing covariance assertion is real-valued. The transfer alone does not assert likelihood-ratio ordering.

The frozen proof gives a different route to the limits, but it does not add a distinct result beyond these demonstrated implications.
